\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[view={0}{90},scale only axis,width=6cm,height=3cm,
  xmin=0,xmax=2,ymin=0,ymax=1,zmin=-1,zmax=1,enlargelimits=false,
  xtick={0,.5,1,1.5,2},ytick={.3,.7},domain=-1:3,samples=5,
  y domain=.3:.7,samples y=2,point meta rel=per plot]
  \addplot3[blue,thick,point meta=x,quiver={u=.7,v=0,
    every arrow/.style={-{Latex[scale length={max(.2,\pgfplotspointmetatransformed/1000)}]}}}] {0};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
